title: Coin Clicker
brief: Tap the big coin to earn coins and buy up to two upgrades that make each tap worth more; reach 80 coins to win.

title: Lemonade Stand
brief: Squeeze lemons, sell cups for cash and buy a sign for bigger profit; reach 40 cash to win.

title: Quiz Night
brief: Answer three multiple-choice questions across three levels; wrong answers cost one of three lives, answering all wins.

title: Green Light
brief: Tap GO only while the light is green; six good taps win, three early taps lose.

title: Lantern Cave
brief: A choose-a-path story told with changing texts; the right three choices escape the cave, wrong ones end the story.

title: Door Counter
brief: Count exactly 12 guests with +1, +3 and -1 buttons, then open the doors; wrong counts cost one of three lives.

title: Robot Workshop
brief: Tap the scrap pile and buy up to four helper bots that gather scrap on their own; reach 150 scrap to win.

title: Color Echo
brief: Watch the pads flash red, green, blue, green, then tap the same order; wrong taps cost lives, replay is available.

title: Vending Coins
brief: Insert 1, 2 and 5 coins to reach exactly 11 for a cola; going over loses.

title: Light Tap
brief: Three lamps light up at random; tap lit ones for points, tap dark ones and lose a life; 12 points win.

title: Combo Lock
brief: Turn three 0-3 dials to the code 2-0-3 and press TRY; wrong tries cost one of three lives.
